package.name: psdk_wrapper
package.description: Native shared library (libpsdk_wrapper.so) wrapping DJI's Payload SDK (PSDK) so dji_psdk_bridge can drive a PSDK-capable aircraft over UART instead of running in stub mode. Requires a real DJI developer app license and a PSDK-capable airframe (M30/M30T, M300/M350 RTK, Matrice 4 series, Mavic 3 Enterprise, ...).
